param p1 = 20 in [7, 60]
param p2 = 100 in [33, 300]
param p3 = 0.02 in [0.005, 0.08]

let f = sma(close, p1)
let s = sma(close, p2)
enter_long when crossover(f, s)
exit_long when crossunder(f, s)
set stop_loss = p3

param p1 = 8 in [3, 24]
param p2 = 5 in [2, 15]
param p3 = 30 in [10, 90]
param p4 = 30 in [10, 90]

enter_long when (crossover(low, sma(close, p1)) or roc(close, p2) < (-0.0167)) and roc(close, p3) > (-0.0171)
exit_long when roc(close, p4) < (-0.0184) or crossunder(ema(close, 80), sma(close, 13))
set stop_loss = 0.0751

param p1 = 80 in [27, 240]
param p2 = 30 in [10, 90]
param p3 = 80 in [27, 240]
param p4 = 13 in [4, 39]

enter_long when rsi(close, p1) > 52
exit_long when roc(close, p2) < (-0.0184) or crossunder(ema(close, p3), sma(close, p4))
set stop_loss = 0.0751

param p1 = 20 in [7, 60]
param p2 = 100 in [33, 300]
param p3 = 30 in [10, 90]
param p4 = 0.02 in [0.005, 0.08]

let f = sma(close, p1)
let s = sma(close, p2)
enter_long when crossover(f, s)
exit_long when crossunder(f, s) or crossunder(rsi(close, p3), 58)
set stop_loss = p4
set trail_stop = 0.0232

param p1 = 80 in [27, 240]
param p2 = 80 in [27, 240]
param p3 = 120 in [40, 360]
param p4 = 50 in [17, 150]

enter_long when (crossover(low, lowest(low, p1)) or crossunder(rsi(close, p2), 68)) and rsi(close, p3) > 69
exit_long when highest(high, p4) > sma(close, 50)
set trail_stop = 0.0381

param p1 = 5 in [2, 15]
param p2 = 80 in [27, 240]
param p3 = 300 in [100, 900]
param p4 = 19 in [7.6, 30.4]

enter_long when rsi(close, p1) > p4
exit_long when roc(close, p2) > 0.0222 or crossover(rsi(close, p3), 66)
set stop_loss = 0.0208
